description: Advisory, unranked grader patterns from settled jury seats in a segment: per grader seats, agreement (vote matched the settled outcome; not accuracy), peers (agreement of the other jurors on the same answers), spread (stdev of 0 to 3 settled scores), top_share (share of the most used score), distance (mean gap to the other jurors' mean score), score mix, closes, with percentiles among non system graders at or above min_n (default 20 scored settled seats). Also medians, distribution bands and a network wide answer to seal timing (never per grader). Segment 1 has no settled scores: agreement and peers only. Pending answers and scores are never read. Use it to see how graders' settled votes and scores spread, not to rank them. CSV at /api/v1/governance/grader-patterns.csv.

dir.description: desc (default: highest first, A to Z for names) or asc (reversed); blanks last

limit.description: maximum graders to return (1 to 5000, default 1000)

min_n.description: rows need this many scored settled seats (settled seats in a segment without scores); 0 returns every grader

range.description: closes in the last 24h, 7d, 30d or all (default)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: row order: name (default, A to Z) or a column, highest first

name: get_grader_patterns
title: Grader patterns
